description: Loop machinery of this repo: the long-running daemons and the per-cycle worker they run. An added or modified listed file needs a commit trailer 'Loop-Proof: <declared test> red=a/b green=c/c' (red before the change, fully green after) naming one of that file's declared tests. A listed file with no declared test cannot change. Deleting a listed file or removing a manifest entry or declared test is refused. Checked by tools/loop_proof_check.py in CI on every PR. Paths are relative to this repo root, POSIX-style.

files.reason: watchdog daemon: long-running backup, PR-sweep and task-ingest cycle loop
self-healing supervisor loop: detects stale heartbeats and restarts dead daemons
per-cycle backup worker run by the watchdog loop; writes the heartbeat on a completed cycle
the Loop-Proof gate itself; changes to it must prove themselves
